author: SenWarren
text:
It's been a year and a half since the Trump Admin stopped regularly sanctioning evaders who help Russia’s war machine. And we've called on the Admin to expose the many entities behind the Kremlin-backed A7 network.

Now, A7 has reportedly moved $6.9 billion through banks. 🧵
